card.line: Ibleam was a city given to the tribe of Manasseh, where Canaanites stayed on, and near where King Ahaziah of Judah was shot while fleeing Jehu.

moments.title: A city given to Manasseh
moments.text: Ibleam was one of the cities assigned to Manasseh, within the lands of Issachar and Asher. It had settlements around it.

moments.title: Canaanites not driven out
moments.text: Manasseh failed to drive out the people of Ibleam and other cities, because the Canaanites were determined to stay. When Israel grew stronger, they made the Canaanites work as forced laborers but never drove them out completely.

moments.title: Ahaziah shot near Ibleam
moments.text: King Ahaziah of Judah fled from Jehu, who shouted for his men to shoot him. They hit him in his chariot on the Ascent of Gur, near Ibleam, and he fled to Megiddo and died there.
